Double Breaker
■ When you put this creature, reveal the top 5 cards of your deck. Put any number of cards that have different card types from among them and put them into your hand. Put the rest of the cards on the bottom of your deck in any order.
■ When this creature leaves, you may play a non-creature card that costs 6 or less from your hand for no cost.
